data.reference_entity: Any zone media player (used to discover source inputs)

data.source_watcher_entity: Watcher entity (what to watch for active playback)
data.app_filter_entity: App filter entity (media player whose current app gates this source — leave blank to auto-use the watcher entity)
data.app_ids: Allowed app IDs (exact app_id or app_name, e.g. com.apple.TVMusic — leave EMPTY to follow on any app, including video)

data.atv_entities: Streaming device(s) — leave blank to skip
data.restore_delay_seconds: Restore delay (seconds before zone re-follows after device stops)
data.airplay_exception: Allow AirPlay exception (zone re-follows if AirPlay active when ATV stops)
data.amp_switch: Amp switch (turn on when device plays, off when restored)
data.bypass_app_ids: Bypass app IDs (exact match — these apps do NOT trigger the exclusion, e.g. com.apple.TVMusic)

abort.no_systems_configured: No audio systems configured. Add a system first.

error.no_systems: No audio systems found. Add a system entry first.
